title: A word game helper
description:
Check words against simple rules with the string library.

```
Letters: retains
Word: stainer
stainer: uses only the letters (7 of 7)
Word: tears
tears: uses only the letters (5 of 7)
Word: treats
treats: needs a second t
```
hints: Count the letters first (`counts[c - 'a']++`), then go through the word subtracting; a count below zero means that letter ran out (lesson 2.05).
Lower-case everything with `tolower` before counting, so `Tears` works too.
requirements: A word is allowed when each letter is used no more times than it appears in the letters.
Count letters with an `int counts[26]` array.
Write `int can_make(const char *word, const char *letters, char *missing)` that stores the first letter that runs out.
stretch: Read a word list from a file and print every word that can be made, longest first.
